_comment: MAGNET SWEEP has ONE place (decision 0001): 'MAGNET SWEEP' placeId 111667188608192, universe 10764307230. studio_game/ is the single sync root; studio_lobby/ is an empty stub kept only so a future lobby split stays cheap - nothing syncs from it and it must not be listed here until it holds a real place. *** EVERY PATH BELOW WAS OBSERVED, NOT ASSUMED *** - probed over MCP in job 002 on 2026-08-29 by writing a marker file into EVERY candidate location at once (so 'nothing appeared' could be told apart from 'this path does not sync') and reading the DataModel back. LAYOUT IS FLAT: service folders sit directly at the sync root, and StarterPlayer's children are StarterPlayerScripts/ and StarterCharacterScripts/ AT THE ROOT - the nested form studio_game/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ synced NOTHING. This matches The Last Tide and contradicts Jungle's nested Rojo convention. File suffix sets the class, also observed: .luau = ModuleScript; .server.luau = Script RunContext=Server; .client.luau = Script RunContext=Client; .local.luau = LocalScript RunContext=Legacy; .module.luau is NOT a recognised suffix - it yields a ModuleScript whose NAME ends in '.module'. TRAP, reproduced in Play: a .client.luau in StarterPlayerScripts RUNS TWICE (once in place, once from the copy in Players.<name>.PlayerScripts) and Roblox logs a warning about it - use .local.luau there. Deleting a file does NOT remove the instance from Studio; sync propagates deletions only in the Studio -> disk direction.
_status: VERIFIED 2026-08-29 (job 002) - observed over MCP, not guessed.

_suffixes..client.luau: Script (RunContext=Client) - NEVER in StarterPlayerScripts, it runs twice
_suffixes..module.luau: NOT a suffix - produces a ModuleScript named '<x>.module'
